highlights.text: “My name is Kinch, or Kinch Na Shannack, or fucking Kinch if you prefer. It won’t be the first time I’ve heard it,”
I won’t be your dog, but if you’re half the wolf I think you are, you’ve found a fox to run with.”

“I didn’t think the bird fell out of your arse.” She took a sip of wine and looked at me seriously. “That would be very dark magic,” I said. She squinted at me, waiting to see where this was going, but not hopeful. “But not black magic.” She waited. “Brown,” I said.
And there’s humanity in a glimpse—we’ve always got a copper for a stone idol, but none for the beggar in its shadow.
